articles.title: Syria says it foiled Hezbollah plot to attack Homs oil refinery
articles.description: Nov 3 - Syrian security forces have arrested members of a cell linked to Lebanese Iran-backed militant group Hezbollah accused of planning to attack the Homs oil refinery in central Syria, state news agency SANA reported on Tuesday. Read more at straitstimes.com.
